UPDATE FOR SUBVERSE MODERATORS

It has come to my attention that the "Hide 'Block' Button" addon has been causing some issues for some users of Voat. After being pointed in the direction of a thread by Moe, I saw that users were complaining of Scribble and the subverses that have decided to remove the "Block" button.

What is the block button?

It's a button that removes the posts of that subverse from your frontpage.

 

Why would I want to see it?

If you don't want to have to switch off the theme for that subverse, click the button, and then re-enable themes, this becomes a problem.

 

Why was this addon even provided to users?

I didn't know what the button did, and I figured it was the same as the "unsubscribe" button. I was wrong. The button was ultimately removed because I thought it fit the aesthetics better. This was not done maliciously. Had the button been important to the administration of this site, they could have corrected it with a simple "display: inline-block !important" in their CSS, or by declaring it was important inline; they chose not to pursue those methods. This doesn't mean the administration is fine with me blocking it, but it does mean that it was never against site rules. Which brings me to my next point...

 

If I use this, or have used it at any point in time, am I at risk of anything?

No, absolutely not. This was never against the rules of Voat or its administrators. Like I said in the last answer: this is something they could have very easily fixed if they wanted to fix it, but they chose not to. Does this mean you won't be banned for its continued use? I'm not sure, and I can't definitively say, as they may change their policy. That being said, if you remove this addon in a timely fashion, I'm sure you'll be just fine. Moe has stated that it isn't against site rules, and thus you cannot be banned for it, or removed as mod from that sub. You also will not have your sub banned because of this. Again, Voat policy may change on this, but, as of the time of this posting, you will not be banned for using it.

 

I am so sorry to anyone affected, and especially the users of Scribble. As the creator of the theme, I take full responsibility for any fallout or criticism. If you or your subverse are coming under attack by the users, please direct them to me, and let them know that I was the one at fault, here. There was already a post about /v/Pics removing the button, and I just want to say, for the record, /u/oaken had nothing to do with its removal; the button was removed in the CSS I provided him to use for his subverse. /v/Pics and its mods are nothing but the finest of people, and want only the best for their users; they would have never consented to such an addon being used, had they known that it would have hurt the people they have been working so hard to help out in so many other ways. Do not take this out on them.

I offer my deepest apologies, and wish to offer my help in correcting this issue. If you have any problems, or want to remove it, but can't, please contact me by private message or in this thread, and I will help out in any way that I can.

Thank you for your understanding, Hewitt
